text:
Alex: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone sync for low-latency routing. TL;DR: what shipped, what slipped, and clear next owners for the remaining items. Please drop one-line status updates and owner confirmations.

Maya: From product side — shipped: routing policy UI + canary toggle. :tada:

Jordan: Eng update — shipped: model selection fallback and perf tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/412 (merged). Added perf dashboard panels.

Ria: FYI infra dependency slipped — internal LB upgrade blocked by networking change in corp-vpc (NET-231). ETA now EOW next week unless NET team can expedite. Owning the unblock: @Jordan for temporary workaround.

Jordan: Agree, I'll scope a short-term kernel-level fallback to avoid LB change. Plan: implement fallback + smoke tests. Owner: Jordan. ETA: Wed 1717005600 (mid-week).

Sam: From product — need checklist for canary rollout gating (metrics and ops steps). I can own the checklist if eng provides the metric thresholds.

Jordan: Proposed gating: p95 latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.2%, token cost delta < 5%. Sharing graphs in console.

Maya: That looks reasonable. Sam please capture as a one-pager and add to the rollout doc.

Alex: Two asks: 1) confirm owners for the two remaining items (LB workaround + rollout checklist). 2) ping for code reviews on the fallback PR once created.

Ria: Owner for LB workaround: Jordan. Owner for rollout checklist: Sam. I'm tracking NET-231 and will escalate if no progress by Tue.

Jordan: I'll open the fallback PR today and tag @Maya and @Alex for review. Short diff, mostly config toggles. Example command to run local smoke test:
```
./tools/run_routing_smoke.sh --model=llama-2-13b --seq=512
```

Sam: I'll draft the checklist and attach thresholds + rollback plan. Will post in this thread when ready.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy job queued for routing-fallback v0.9. Running preflight checks... :gear:

Jordan: CR ping: @Maya @Alex — draft PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/421 (WIP). Would appreciate quick review this afternoon.

Maya: Reviewing now, should be able to get to it by 4pm PT.

Alex: Great — once fallback is reviewed & merged, Ria please coordinate NET escalation timeline with Sam's rollout doc so we can set a final ship date.

Ria: Will do. Noting next steps in NET-231 and adding Sam as observer.

Sam: Checklist draft posted: https://redwood-internal/docs/rollouts/routing-canary (commented). Includes target metrics and rollback steps.

Alex: Perfect. Final ask — everyone please add a single bullet to the doc with any known risks. We'll reconvene in the weekly sync if NET team doesn't unblock by Tue. :thumbsup:
